works.title: Ein Lied für Dich
works.publicNote: German-language feature film directed by Joe May, with music credited to Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann. French-language version: Tout pour l’amour (F025).

works.title: Trouble for Two
works.publicNote: Bronisław Kaper’s involvement is documented as probable background or uncredited cue work rather than a conventional on-screen score credit. Some of this material is associated with Franz Waxman.

works.title: Wings of the Morning
works.publicNote: Marche militaire from Les nuits moscovites

works.title: The Spy Ring
works.publicNote: The Spy Ring is included only as probable stock or background-music context. No direct cue sheet, soundtrack documentation, or period music credit currently confirms a Kaper score or song contribution.

works.title: Little Boy Blue
works.publicNote: Animated short, also circulated as The Big Bad Wolf (1936). Buxbaum/Sieghardt associates Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann with background cues and lists Carl W. Stalling as an additional music contributor; Ub Iwerks produced and directed the film, which was distributed by MGM.

works.title: Wir sind international
works.publicNote: The song itself is documented, but its association with Die große Attraktion remains probable rather than confirmed.
